title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.67 (quiet) at 01:14 UTC on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日 01:14 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.67（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest complete-minute estimated Kp = 0.67 (label 1M). Last-180-sample maximum is 2.00 (at 23:57 UTC); published-window maximum is 2.00 (at 23:57 UTC). Hours through 18:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window. Residual 19:00 UTC slice: peak 0.67 / 1M (42 samples, closed at 0.67 / 1M). Completed bins 20:00–00:00 UTC closed at 0.67 / 1.33 / 1.67 / 2.00 / 0.00 respectively. In-progress 01:00 UTC bin: 0.67 / 1M after 15 samples. estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新完整分鐘估計 Kp = 0.67（標籤 1M）。近 180 筆最大 2.00（23:57 UTC）；公開窗最大 2.00（23:57 UTC）。至 18:00 UTC 已滾出公開窗。殘留 19:00 UTC 切片：峰值 0.67／1M（42 筆，收在 0.67／1M）。20:00–00:00 UTC 已結束（分別收在 0.67／1.33／1.67／2.00／0.00）。01:00 UTC 進行中（15 筆、目前 0.67／1M）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest complete minute (not a lone new-hour 0.00 placeholder). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~355 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file.

title.en: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake occurred in the Kermadec Islands region on 18 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 18 日，克馬德克群島海域發生規模 5.5 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mww 5.5, depth about 94 km. Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.5 (us7000tigd).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mww 5.5，深度約 94 公里。本小時新上架。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 5.5（us7000tigd）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
